content:
Please switch the puzzle to WIP as there are significant issues that should be addressed first. (Consider switching your other puzzle to WIP too; I'll review it later today.)

Goal
* There are several issues with the current statement:

  • "Parameter" is undefined.

  • "Secret" is undefined in the phrase "secret value". How should a solver determine whether a value is secret?

  • The token-boundary constraint is unclear in how it applies to the rules. Moreover, the beginning-of-line boundary isn't included.
  
  • The token-boundary definition is more than an input constraint: it is part of the matching rules and is necessary for correctly parsing and transforming the raw log entries.

  • Including the pattern [a-zA-Z0-9]+ gives away a hint, as it can potentially be used directly in the solution, and, in fact, it's used in your solution.

  • The statement is silent on overlapping occurrences. For example,

    - What should happen when there are 5 or more consecutive 4-digit tokens joined by "-", e.g. "1234-2234-3234-4234-5234"? Should the first 4 tokens be redacted, or should the entire sequence be regarded as not matching the credit-card pattern?

    - In particular, your code interprets 8 consecutive 4-digit tokens jointed by hyphens as two consecutive credit-card numbers and redacts them separately. I don't think that is necessarily the intended interpretation; such a sequence could, for example, represent a recovery code.

    - Similarly, how should "token=token=123" be handled? Your code currently redacts both the second "token" and 123.

* In view of these issues, consider dropping the term "parameter", moving the token-boundary constraint to the Goal section, and rewriting as follows. 

-----

<<Tokens>> are bounded by non-alphanumeric characters or the beginning or end of the line.

Inspect a stream of server log lines and sanitize all occurrences of the following two patterns, subject to the overlapping rule.

1. <<Credit card numbers>>

Exactly four consecutive tokens, each consisting of exactly 4 digits and joined by {{-}}, form a credit card number and should be replaced with {{[CARD_REDACTED]}}

2. <<API token>>

A token {{token}}, immediately followed by {{=}} and another token (the <<value>>) consisting of one or more alphanumeric characters, forms an API token. Redact the value token only, replacing it with {{[TOKEN_REDACTED]}}.

<<Overlapping rule>>

Overlapping occurrences of a single pattern should not be considered to fit the pattern and should remain unchanged. For example, this applies to:

• Eight consecutive tokens, each consisting of exactly 4 digits and joined by {{-}}.

• {{token=}} appears consecutively two or more times.

-----

(character limit reached)

*Difficulty
Please change Easy to Nromal

Thanks

It's probably closer to Easy than Medium (there’s no Normal or Nromal difficulty). Also note that regex isn't really needed to solve the puzzle.

(I'll send you a reference on puzzle classification after the forum is fixed (I can't log in right now.)

There are a few issues with the task description and case coverage, though. I'm going to finish my review today.

(continued)

* Note that this rewritten specification does *not* match your code's behaviour, but I believe it better reflects the intended behaviour. An example is the situation of 8 consecutive 4-digit tokens all joined by a hyphen as mentioned earlier.

* Note also that the rewritten version (*unlike* your current code) treats any non-alphanumeric character immediately preceding "token" as a token boundary. Thus, "php?my_token=abc" would contain a "token=abc" API token.

* The rewritten version (*like* your current code) treats any non-alphanumeric character immediately following an API value token as a token boundary. Thus, "php?token=abc_my" would contain a "token=abc" API token, and "_my" isn't part of it.

* The statement should also clarify how to handle the situation when "token=" is immediately followed by a credit card number.

Input
* Please add the variable name [[line]] after "A string".

Output
* Please remove "with all sensitive card numbers and tokens redacted" as it suggests a scope wider than intended.

Constraints
* Please change 50 to 10 as [[N]] never exceeds 10.

* Please change the second constraint to: [[line]] contains between 1 and 100 printable ASCII characters.

* Also note that 250 has been replaced by 100 because no raw log entry is longer than 100 characters.

* Please remove the third constraint. This should be moved to the Goal section, as explained above.

Stub generator
* Please change 250 to 100.

Tags
* Please use existing tags and replace "regular-expressions" with "Regular expressions".

* Please also remove the "security" tag.

Cases
* Currently "token=" followed by a token at the end of a raw log entry appears in Validators 1 and 2 but not in any tests. Please modify Test 1 and/or Test 2 to include the same scenario.

* Please add new pairs of cases covering scenarios not currently tested:

  • A credit card number at the beginning of a raw log entry

  • 3 or fewer groups of 4-digit tokens joined by a hyphen

  • 5 or more groups of 4-digit tokens joined by a hyphen

  • An otherwise valid credit card number immediately preceded by one or more letters

  • An otherwise valid credit card number immediately preceded by one or more digits

  • An otherwise valid credit card number immediately followed by one or more letters

  • An otherwise valid credit card number immediately followed by one or more digits

  • An otherwise valid credit card number uses multiple hyphens instead of a single hyphen

  • "token=" appearing consecutively

  • "token=" with variations in letter case

  • "token:" instead of "token="

  • a raw log entry ending with "token=" with nothing following

  • "token=" followed by a credit card number

  • "token=" followed by one or more non-alphanumeric non-space characters

  • "token=" preceded by one or more non-alphanumeric non-space characters

Thanks.
